Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of IBM.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1453 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 37 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2020.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1453 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Revenue guidance of $28.4 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $28.4 billion this quarter, representing 21% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
